title: The caller's active project sessions are enumerable, revocable one at a time, and revocable in bulk-except-current
description: The blueprint contributes the `sessionInventory` capability against its own opaque-handle session store (the session-record store contributed by the composed persistence blueprint, or the reference in-memory store for the small-project shape). An authenticated caller can list their active project sessions, revoke one non-current session by id, and revoke every active session except the one making the call. Each list row carries `{ sessionId, deviceLabel, lastActive, currentSession }`; the interface shape is inherited by reference from `security-auth-clerk` `TAC-1003` `interfaces.sessionInventory` and is not restated on oauth2. Every operation refuses an unauthenticated caller with `SESSION_INVENTORY_UNAUTHENTICATED`; every operation emits one structured audit event carrying operation, session id prefix and wall-clock timestamp; no field carries a full session id, a cookie value, or a provider token.
rationale: A capability declaration without a REQ backing the surface leaves consumers to bind against a contract oauth2 never wrote down. The cross-blueprint reference keeps the interface shape single-owner (clerk's TAC-1003) while letting each auth blueprint fulfil the capability against its own session store.
